overall_summary: Initial tests on digital self-respect (deleting chats, blocking) showed modest views (10-41 views). However, the channel experienced a massive spike in engagement and views when expanding into universal family emotional connections (Maa, Papa, Bhai, calling loved ones), with 'आज किसी अपने को Call कर लेना' hitting 278 views. The core channel topic of relationships/family outpaces niche digital breakup tropes.

winning_patterns.pattern: Universal Family & Close Relationship Emotional Hooks
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about Maa (215 views), Papa (133 views), and calling loved ones (278 views) significantly outperformed niche digital breakup content.
winning_patterns.action: Pivot focus toward universal human bonds, quiet sacrifices, and family relationships while maintaining the emotional tone of Dil Ki Diary.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos referencing daily emotional micro-moments like asking 'खाना खाया?' or checking up on family gained high traction compared to abstract heartbreak quotes.
winning_patterns.action: Use concrete daily actions as hooks instead of abstract relationship theories.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeatedly making videos about deleting chats, un-pinning chats, and changing keyboard names yielded diminishing returns (some dropping to 0-6 views).
weak_patterns.action: Reduce reliance on digital phone-screen breakup tropes and explore wider emotional life reflections.
